engine: ANALOG-X Regional Terrain Window Discovery & Robustness Engine

scientific_contract.unit_of_analysis: 5.55 km × 5.55 km regional terrain windows sampled inside ten pre-selected 30 km Earth study/reference areas
scientific_contract.score_interpretation: Exploratory terrain-only proximity index using equal-weight, IQR-normalized absolute gaps in median slope, P90 slope and P90 3×3 local relief. It is not a probability, geological match, mission score or landing-suitability assessment.
scientific_contract.scale_limit: Earth inputs are Copernicus DEM GLO-30 DSM resampled to ~925 m; the Moon input is 80 m LOLA aggregated to ~925 m; Mars uses ~925 m MOLA. The 5.55 km windows retain ~925 m spatial support.
scientific_contract.window_overlap: Sliding windows overlap and are spatially dependent. Weight sensitivity is not a statistical confidence interval.
scientific_contract.candidate_limit: Results identify candidate sub-windows within the ten existing study regions only. They are not a whole-Earth scan or newly validated geological analog discoveries.
scientific_contract.coordinate_note: Displayed WGS84 window centres are approximate offsets from each parent study-area reference centre using nominal grid spacing. They are map locators, not surveyed coordinates, field-station positions or parcel boundaries.
physical_nontransferability: Earth gravity and atmosphere differ from the Moon and Mars.
Terrain similarity does not measure lithology, mineralogy, regolith strength, dust, water or radiation.
No rover-scale trafficability, landing safety, resource access or base suitability is inferred.
scientific_contract.inspiration_and_method_note: The transparent IQR-normalized terrain-distance and stability ideas were independently implemented after reviewing public NASA Space Apps examples from Team Shoemaker and Earth Analog Explorer. No competitor source code is copied into this engine.

target.name: Shackleton Rim / lunar south pole
target.source: NASA LRO LOLA PDS GDR LDEM_80S_80M aggregated to ~925 m
target.source_coverage: 32×32 interpolated elevation grid; LDEC reports 99.99488830566406% mean native-pixel return support per coarse cell

scan.valid_window_rule: At least 26/36 valid elevation cells and 15 valid slope and relief samples
scan.stability_definition: Percentage of random Dirichlet(1,1,1) feature-weight draws for which this window ranked in the top decile of its own 30 km parent region. Rank sensitivity only—not analog probability or statistical confidence.
scan.selection_rule: Up to 30 windows, max 4 per parent region, at least 6.0 km apart

atfa_context.priority_experiment: Validate debris/ice classification with field transects and temperature measurements; do not equate glacier ice with lunar PSR ice.

nasa_power.limitation: Gridded climatology; not a local weather station, surface temperature, dust flux or resource measurement.

sentinel2.statement: Integrated
sentinel2.limitation: Spectral indices and RGB previews are screening context, not mineral identification or ground truth.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Glacier/debris interpretation and cold-region sensor methods are relevant; the national glacier inventory is prior work, not a new ANALOG-X discovery.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Debris-versus-ice mapping, thermal/optical sensor calibration, cold equipment trials and field logistics in difficult terrain.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: Terrestrial glacier ice is not equivalent to lunar permanently shadowed regolith ice; pressure, sublimation, gravity and radiation differ.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Pair thermal imagery with ground temperature strings, snow/ice pits, dielectric measurements and independently validated ice/debris boundaries.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Coarse terrain profile is useful for regional context only; crevasses and local hazards are unresolved.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: DEM processing, slope/relief interpretation, route-planning workflows and sensor-fusion procedures can be rehearsed on terrestrial terrain.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: Earth gravity, atmosphere, soil cohesion, vegetation, hydrology and vehicle dynamics differ; 925 m terrain cells cannot resolve rover-scale hazards.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Acquire metre-to-centimetre DEM/LiDAR, grain-size and bearing-strength observations; validate traverses with an instrumented rover.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Sentinel-2 context can rehearse snow/ice screening but requires field validation and seasonal controls.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Scene selection, atmospheric/cloud screening, spectral-index QA, field spectroscopy and orbital-to-ground provenance workflows.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: Earth vegetation, water, atmosphere and biological coatings alter spectra; Sentinel-2 bands are not a substitute for lunar/Martian instrument response or mineral identification.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Collect calibrated field spectra and XRD/XRF/FTIR samples, then compare with the relevant planetary instrument response functions.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: High-altitude remote field logistics and equipment endurance are testable.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Remote team coordination, navigation interfaces, sampling workflows, communications procedures, logistics and human-factors evaluation.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: No Earth field site reproduces EVA suits, vacuum, radiation, reduced gravity, lunar dust electrostatics or Mars atmospheric constraints.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Run a controlled mission simulation with timed tasks, comms latency, equipment failure injection and documented operator workload.

target.name: Nili Patera / Mars
target.source_coverage: 50.53% observed-cell coverage in the parent 30 km grid; 87 complete 3×3 neighborhoods. Only local windows meeting the explicit validity threshold are ranked.

scan.valid_window_rule: At least 26/36 valid elevation cells and 15 valid slope and relief samples
scan.stability_definition: Percentage of random Dirichlet(1,1,1) feature-weight draws for which this window ranked in the top decile of its own 30 km parent region. Rank sensitivity only—not analog probability or statistical confidence.
scan.selection_rule: Up to 30 windows, max 4 per parent region, at least 6.0 km apart

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Extreme saline/hydrothermal setting is relevant for testing contamination-control and assay workflows; no site-specific ANALOG-X biological measurements are integrated and life claims are not made.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Field blank design, contamination-controlled sampling, instrument cleaning, chain-of-custody, extremophile habitat mapping and laboratory assay workflows can be rehearsed in terrestrial extreme environments.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: Earth biology, oxygen, liquid water, organic background and terrestrial contamination differ fundamentally; finding Earth extremophiles does not demonstrate extraterrestrial life or validate a Mars biosignature.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Run contamination-controlled transects with field blanks, replicate samples, metagenomic or targeted assays, mineral-organic co-location and independent laboratory validation.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Hyperarid field protocols can rehearse low-biomass sampling and contamination control; this is a method analogue, not evidence of Mars-like life.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Field blank design, contamination-controlled sampling, instrument cleaning, chain-of-custody, extremophile habitat mapping and laboratory assay workflows can be rehearsed in terrestrial extreme environments.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: Earth biology, oxygen, liquid water, organic background and terrestrial contamination differ fundamentally; finding Earth extremophiles does not demonstrate extraterrestrial life or validate a Mars biosignature.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Run contamination-controlled transects with field blanks, replicate samples, metagenomic or targeted assays, mineral-organic co-location and independent laboratory validation.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Arid dust/surface monitoring is relevant; wind climatology alone does not quantify dust emission.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Wind-sensor deployment, particle collection, surface-change monitoring, dust-camera calibration and threshold-measurement procedures.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: Earth air density, humidity, grain charging, gravity and wind stress differ substantially; 10 m wind speed is not dust flux or saltation threshold.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Measure particle-size distribution, threshold friction velocity, vertical dust flux, humidity and surface crust strength using a calibrated field station.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Salt-flat and hyperarid mapping methods can support selected Martian sedimentary questions.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Basin mapping, sediment facies logging, salt-crust morphology, desiccation structures and repeat-observation methods.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: Earth liquid water, rainfall, groundwater, biology and atmospheric pressure create processes absent or different on the Moon and many Martian settings.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Map facies and stratigraphy; collect mineralogical samples, electrical conductivity, shallow cores and repeat wet/dry observations.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Useful setting for orbital-to-ground validation; no new site-specific spectral classification is asserted.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Scene selection, atmospheric/cloud screening, spectral-index QA, field spectroscopy and orbital-to-ground provenance workflows.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: Earth vegetation, water, atmosphere and biological coatings alter spectra; Sentinel-2 bands are not a substitute for lunar/Martian instrument response or mineral identification.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Collect calibrated field spectra and XRD/XRF/FTIR samples, then compare with the relevant planetary instrument response functions.

source_references.title: A Polyextreme Hydrothermal System Controlled by Iron: The Case of Dallol at the Afar Triangle
source_references.publisher: ACS Earth and Space Chemistry / peer-reviewed research
source_references.supports: Geochemical description of the Dallol hydrothermal system and evaporite interaction.

atfa_context.priority_experiment: Use published geochemistry and safe, permitted field observations to distinguish hydrothermal salts from remote-sensing look-alikes.

nasa_power.limitation: Gridded climatology; not a local weather station, surface temperature, dust flux or resource measurement.

terrain.limitation: Where available, ~925 m regional descriptors cannot establish rover-scale trafficability or landing safety.

sentinel2.statement: No site-specific Sentinel-2 processing is recorded in the candidate dossier.
sentinel2.limitation: Spectral indices and RGB previews are screening context, not mineral identification or ground truth.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Extreme saline/hydrothermal setting is relevant for testing contamination-control and assay workflows; no site-specific ANALOG-X biological measurements are integrated and life claims are not made.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Field blank design, contamination-controlled sampling, instrument cleaning, chain-of-custody, extremophile habitat mapping and laboratory assay workflows can be rehearsed in terrestrial extreme environments.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: Earth biology, oxygen, liquid water, organic background and terrestrial contamination differ fundamentally; finding Earth extremophiles does not demonstrate extraterrestrial life or validate a Mars biosignature.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Run contamination-controlled transects with field blanks, replicate samples, metagenomic or targeted assays, mineral-organic co-location and independent laboratory validation.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Saline hydrothermal and evaporite settings offer process/mapping methods; Earth hydrology and biology are major differences.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Basin mapping, sediment facies logging, salt-crust morphology, desiccation structures and repeat-observation methods.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: Earth liquid water, rainfall, groundwater, biology and atmospheric pressure create processes absent or different on the Moon and many Martian settings.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Map facies and stratigraphy; collect mineralogical samples, electrical conductivity, shallow cores and repeat wet/dry observations.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Hydrothermal/volcanic context is relevant to mapping methods, not a direct lunar lava analogue.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Lava-flow morphology mapping, roughness characterization, tube/cave reconnaissance and orbital-to-ground geologic mapping methods.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: Earth weathering, vegetation, atmosphere, gravity and composition differ; andesite or altered tuff must not be called basaltic equivalence.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Map flow units and clast sizes; obtain petrography, XRF/XRD and high-resolution terrain/cave surveys.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Spectral workflows can be rehearsed, but no site-specific ANALOG-X mineral classification is integrated.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Scene selection, atmospheric/cloud screening, spectral-index QA, field spectroscopy and orbital-to-ground provenance workflows.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: Earth vegetation, water, atmosphere and biological coatings alter spectra; Sentinel-2 bands are not a substitute for lunar/Martian instrument response or mineral identification.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Collect calibrated field spectra and XRD/XRF/FTIR samples, then compare with the relevant planetary instrument response functions.

experiment_tracks.why_this_site: Extreme-environment operations are relevant but access, safety and corrosive chemistry need specialist controls.
experiment_tracks.what_can_be_rehearsed: Remote team coordination, navigation interfaces, sampling workflows, communications procedures, logistics and human-factors evaluation.
experiment_tracks.analogy_breaks: No Earth field site reproduces EVA suits, vacuum, radiation, reduced gravity, lunar dust electrostatics or Mars atmospheric constraints.
experiment_tracks.next_measurement: Run a controlled mission simulation with timed tasks, comms latency, equipment failure injection and documented operator workload.
